items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: I played second cornet. Joe was playing first.

ctx.x: Let's see now. So, you came back and you didn't play with the straws again at all until May or so?

Uh, well, I, I think maybe I sat in twice with them playing trombone. One time I played, uh, I played the cornet. I played second cornet. Joe was playing first. And I, we tried to work up, uh, Oliver Armstrong get up, you see, with the first and second cornets. And, uh, well, after Joe left, well, of course, I had some big shoes to walk into, because, uh, Joe, I thought Joe, I tried to copy Joe's style. I think Joe was terrific. I mean, other people might have a different idea, you know, a different opinion of…
Yeah. When did you, uh, start playing spots with the straws?
